findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "log_cardio" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_camera, get_weekly_review · Private data: log_cardio, record_checkin, show_progress_chart · Public sink: save_plan, read_meal_photo_upload · Destructive: delete_set, log_cardio, delete_food_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_camera, get_weekly_review · Private data: log_cardio, record_checkin, show_progress_chart · Public sink: save_plan, read_meal_photo_upload · Destructive: delete_set, log_cardio, delete_food_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
